meta.title: Business Location Estonia shows a VAT Tax ID field

args.goal: On the broker's Add Supplier form, select Estonia in Business Location and verify the Tax ID field is labelled VAT; select another country and verify its country-specific Tax ID field appears; return to Estonia and stop with the VAT Tax ID field visible

steps.note: Performs the country selections and observes the dynamic Tax ID field because no catalog domain step covers the Add Supplier form.
Confirms the final Estonia state visibly shows the expected VAT Tax ID label.
